stemMd: A tariff is $C=F+rn$, with $r\ne0$. Express $n$ in terms of $C,F,r$.
explanationMd: Subtract the fixed charge first, giving $C-F=rn$, then divide by the unit rate. Substituting the result into the tariff returns C.

distractorRationale.b: Reverses the subtraction and changes the sign.
distractorRationale.d: Divides only the total charge, not the whole difference.
distractorRationale.c: Multiplies instead of dividing by the rate.
